## Analysis: Emily OS RSI Token Spend

### EMILY RSI Engine (this cycle — IMPLEMENTED)
- Prior: system prompt sent uncached, no beta header → ~14,000T overhead/task
- Fix: AnthropicClient.Complete() now uses content-block array + cache_control:ephemeral
- Also: cr.Value truncated to ≤120 chars in buildGenerationPrompt
- Savings: ~6,300T/task (90% on 700T system × 10 calls)
- EMILY commit 57cfb90

### FatBaby emily-agent (prior cycle — already fixed, commit 7b7d688)
- ~35,640T/tick savings (81% reduction on 4,400T system+tools prefix)

### observation-watcher dispatches (next cycle)
- batch-window mode exists but opt-in; enable 60s default → amortise ~600T footer/batch
- rules-JSON skip when hash unchanged → save ~500T/entity-graph dispatch

## Prioritised remaining
1. Enable --batch-window 60s default for prime-task dispatch
2. Skip rules-JSON inline when entity-graph-rules.json hash unchanged
title: Token efficiency RSI: EMILY AnthropicClient prompt caching (task-2263691656595819891)
